evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `.github/workflows/denylist.yml:105` sets `DIFF_OPTS` without `--no-renames`. Git's default rename detection makes a pure rename appear only as rename metadata with no added patch text; gitleaks scans the diff text, so a file moved from an exempt path to a non-exempt path is not rescanned under its new path, and path-based denylist rules can be bypassed. Adding `--no-renames` to the template and regenerating the workflow is the smallest compatible fix.
